race.description: Wickham Freight Lines/Maydan Livestock Transport Warwick Cup
race.comment: CAPE CRUSADER (1) gets top billing after a strong start to the prep. Finished just behind THE CATCH last time but strips fitter third-up and meets that runner 4kgs better after Galloway's claim. Suspect that's enough to turn the tables. Tough to knock the recent form of THE CATCH (9) and the subsequent form around him stacking up strongly. Just needs to hold his form and he will be right there again. LUTON HOO (7) will find this a bit easier and will enjoy some weight relief. Drops back to a winning trip and can be blending in at the right time. CAPITAL ASSET (3) doesn't win out of turn but is the likely leader and will prove hard to reel in if left alone through the middle stages. THE DEPUTY (4) has been building into this and can cause a late scare if they overdo it in front.
